page.layout: One column of text. Year numbers sit in the left margin beside each entry, and line numbers 5 to 35 sit in the right margin. Running head "BIBLICUS" with page number 479 at the top. Catchword "ditos." at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: An.M. fugit. 2.Sam.13. Hoc tempore floruerunt Asaph, Ethan, & Heman, Psalmistae. 1.Chron.25.
2916. Absolom tertio anno à cæde reuocatur operâ Ioabi. 2.Sam.14.
2919. Absolom eiicit patrem regno: sed vincitur & 5 occiditur. 2.Sam.15.16.17.18.
2929. Salomon adit regnum, idque administrat 40. annos, quamdiu pater regnauerat. 1.Reg.11.v.42. Petit & impetrat à Deo sapientiam. 1.Reg.3.v.6.
main_text.head: Quintum intervallum, à fundatione 15 templi Salomonis usq; ad captiuitatem Babylonicam.
main_text.p: 2932. Templum Salomonis fundatur, anno 480. (in-eunte) ab exitu. 1.Reg.4.v.1. mense secundo, siue 20 Maio, anno 4. Salomonis, iuvante Hiramo rege Tyri. 1.Reg.5.v.3.
2934. Maiestas & sapientia Salomonis longè lateq; percrebescit. 1.Reg.3.4.10.
2938. Templo septem annorum spatio absoluto, ce-25 lebrantur eius encænia, anno ii. regni Salomonis. 1.Reg.6.
2941. Salomon componit varia cantica, & de variis rebus sapientissimè disserit. 1.Reg.4.v.32.33.
1951. Salomon constituit politiam sacram & ciui-30 lem. 1.Reg.8.&9.
2952. Regia Salomonis perficitur. 1.Reg.9.v.10. Regina Sabæ venit Hierosolymam. 1.Reg.10.

page.notes: The Greek word in the 2925 entry is not legible on the scan, so it is marked as illegible. The year 1969 is doubtful and marked with [?]. The number 1951 may be misread. The catchword "ditos." is the first word of the next page. The 'An.M.' label at the top left is a column heading for the year numbers. Show-through and the neighbouring page's edge at the left and right were left out.
